title: Kenapa troli penuh susah didorong?
question: Kenapa troli belanja yang penuh lebih susah didorong, padahal beratnya nggak kita angkat?
audience: Orang Indonesia yang belanja ke supermarket dan nonton video pendek. Mereka tahu troli penuh terasa berat, tapi mengira itu soal berat yang harus diangkat atau ditahan, bukan soal massa.
promise: Yang bikin troli penuh susah didorong itu massanya, bukan beratnya: dorongan yang sama ke massa tiga kali lipat cuma menghasilkan sepertiga percepatan, dan dia juga tiga kali lebih susah dihentikan.

loop.line: Itulah kenapa / troli penuh lebih susah didorong, padahal beratnya nggak kamu angkat sama sekali.
loop.picture: The last shot slides back to the opening picture: the figure leaning into the loaded trolley, the same pixels as frame 0.

look.mood: The Stickman template: warm off-white paper with grain and a soft vignette, black ink drawn on stroke by stroke and boiling over a faint pencil sketch that runs past it, lettering written letter by letter and rubbed out, never faded; one marker colour (yellow) for the word or the number that matters, and nothing else in colour. Each page is a sheet laid over the last. Characters on twos.

music.track: Composed for this film (ElevenLabs Music, music/bed.mp3)
music.note: A light acoustic bed (ukulele, pizzicato, soft claps), composed to the take's length; it thins under the numbers and lifts on the payoff. Pen scratches as lines draw and as letters are written, a rub for each erasure, a thump for each item of shopping, skids in s12. The cuts follow the take.

facts.claim: A real supermarket trolley: the Wanzl ELT7/130, with a 131-litre basket, weighs 21 kg (load capacity 131 kg). The film calls the empty trolley 'sekitar dua puluh satu kilo' and writes '21 kg' and the model on screen.
facts.source: Wanzl, Shopping trolleys catalogue (1193_Shopping-trolleys_EN.pdf, wanzl.com), 'Order section for ELT series': ELT7/130, basket volume 131 l, load capacity 131 kg, weight 21.0 kg.

facts.claim: On a level floor you do not lift the trolley: its weight is carried by the wheels and held up by the floor (the floor's upward push balances the weight). Simplification: the film draws two equal arrow pairs; there are four wheels.
facts.source: NASA Glenn Research Center, Beginner's Guide, 'Newton's Laws of Motion' and 'Weight' (grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12): a body at rest has balanced forces.

facts.claim: Inertia (Newton's first law): a body at rest stays at rest, and a body in motion keeps moving at the same speed, unless an outside force acts on it.
facts.source: NASA Glenn Research Center, 'Newton's First Law of Motion' (grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/airplane/newton1g.html).

facts.claim: Newton's second law: F = m × a, so a = F / m. With the same push F, three times the mass gives a third of the acceleration. Starting from rest for the same time t, the distance is a t² / 2, so the full trolley covers a third as far (the film's lanes: 560 px and 187 px).
facts.source: NASA Glenn Research Center, 'Newton's Second Law of Motion' (grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/BGP/newton2.html); 'Motion equations' (grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/airplane/motion.html) for distance = a t² / 2.

facts.claim: The shopping is an example: 42 kg (a big week's shop: drinks, rice, detergent). 21 + 42 = 63 kg, and 63 / 21 = 3: three times the empty trolley's mass. On screen: '21 + 42 = 63 kg' and '3×'.
facts.source: Arithmetic from f1; the 42 kg is chosen for the example and is said as one ('Tambah belanjaan empat puluh dua kilo').

facts.claim: Stopping: with the same braking force F from the same speed v, the deceleration is F / m and the stopping distance is v² / (2a) = m v² / (2F), proportional to the mass. Three times the mass: three times the distance (the film's marks: 180 px and 540 px). The braking arrow is drawn the same length as s09's push ('sekuat tadi'). Rolling friction is ignored in both lanes.
facts.source: NASA Glenn Research Center, 'Newton's Second Law of Motion' and 'Motion equations' (v² = 2 a d), as f4; the arithmetic is shown in storyboard.build.py.

facts.claim: The weight is not irrelevant: rolling at a steady walk, the wheels' rolling resistance is about Crr × N, where N is the weight the wheels carry, so a full trolley also takes a little more push to keep going. For hard wheels on a smooth floor Crr is small, so it is a small force next to the push needed to start or stop the mass. The film says 'bukan beratnya' and writes '(terutama saat mulai & berhenti)' under it, so the claim is about starting and stopping.
facts.source: Rolling resistance, F = Crr × N (Wikipedia, 'Rolling resistance', en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rolling_resistance: definition and typical coefficients); Newton's second law for the push to start or stop the mass (f4, f6).

acts.title: Pertanyaan
acts.goal: The puzzle: hard to push, yet never lifted.

acts.title: Kelembaman
acts.goal: Not weight: inertia, and it grows with mass.

acts.title: Tiga kali
acts.goal: A real trolley, a real load, the arithmetic of a third.

acts.title: Susah berhenti
acts.goal: The same mass also resists stopping: three times the distance.

acts.title: Jawaban
acts.goal: Mass, not weight; then the bridge into the first line.

shots.voice: Troli penuh lebih susah didorong, padahal beratnya nggak kamu *angkat* sama sekali.
shots.teaches: The puzzle: a full trolley is hard to push, yet you never lift it.
shots.screen: Warm paper. A hand-drawn floor across the frame at y 1150. A stick figure leans into a shopping trolley piled with three boxes of shopping; push arrow from the hands; sweat flicks by the head.
shots.motion: Frame 0 is finished. The figure winds back, then shoves with a step (on twos); a horizontal arrow 'dorong' draws on from his hands, and the trolley starts to creep, slowly gaining speed: heavy to get going, not stuck. On 'angkat' an upward arrow is drawn and crossed out. The caption's key word is 'angkat'.
shots.transition: Hold, then the camera pushes in on the face.
shots.sound: Paper bed starts; a strained 'hngg' is the voice's, a creak on the shove.
shots.check: The trolley reads as a trolley at a glance; the figure is leaning, not standing.

frames.note: Frame 0 is finished: the figure leaning into the loaded trolley, both drawn and still.
The shove: the figure rocks back then forward; the trolley moves a hair and stops.
On 'angkat' a dotted arrow points up from the trolley with a cross through it: you never lift it.

shots.screen: Close on the figure's head: a big hand-drawn question mark draws on beside it.
shots.motion: Camera push to the face; the question mark draws on in two strokes.
shots.transition: Cut to a side view of the wheels.
shots.sound: A pen scratch for the question mark.
shots.check: Readable as a question in under a second.

frames.note: Push in: the head and shoulders fill the upper half.
A big question mark beside the head.

shots.voice: Semua beratnya ditahan roda ke lantai.
shots.teaches: The weight goes down through the wheels into the floor; the floor holds it.
shots.screen: The trolley side-on, larger. Ink arrows from the basket down to the two wheel pairs; arrows of the same length from the floor back up. Label 'berat' with a curved leader, 'lantai yang menahan' under the floor.
shots.motion: The down arrows draw on from the load to the wheels; the up arrows answer from the floor.
shots.transition: The arrows are rubbed out; the camera pulls back over the whole trolley and 'Kelembaman' is written across the top.
shots.sound: Two soft taps as the arrows land.
shots.check: Down and up arrows are the same length.

frames.note: The loaded trolley, larger, centred on the floor.
Weight arrows from the load down to the wheels.
The floor pushes back up: equal arrows; label 'lantai menahan'.

shots.voice: Yang kamu lawan itu hal lain: *kelembaman*.
shots.teaches: Names the real thing you fight: inertia.
shots.screen: The word KELEMBAMAN hand-lettered big across the upper third, a marker swipe under it; the small trolley below.
shots.motion: The word writes on letter by letter; the marker swipes under it on the word in the voice.
shots.transition: The word slides up as a ball rolls in.
shots.sound: A marker squeak under the swipe.
shots.check: The word is the biggest thing on the page.

frames.note: The word starts to write on.
The whole word with its marker swipe.

shots.voice: Benda yang diam maunya tetap diam.
shots.teaches: Inertia, part one: what is at rest stays at rest unless something pushes it.
shots.screen: Back to the opening page: the figure shoves the full trolley again and it only creeps. Label 'diam' with a curved leader to the trolley, then 'maunya tetap diam' above. (Built without the ball: the same push on the same trolley carries the idea, and the page stays one picture.)
shots.motion: The shove, then the trolley creeps forward, slowly gaining speed.
shots.transition: A second trolley slides in beside it.
shots.sound: A light roll; a heavy creak.
shots.check: It reads as heavy to start, not stuck: the trolley keeps creeping.

frames.note: The trolley at rest; label 'diam'.
The figure pushes; arrow; the trolley hardly moves.
Label: 'maunya tetap diam'.

shots.voice: Makin besar massanya, makin susah diubah geraknya.
shots.teaches: Inertia grows with mass: more mass, harder to change its motion.
shots.screen: Two trolleys side by side: empty (left, label 'massa kecil') and full (right, 'massa besar'); under the floor 'susah diubah geraknya:' and a hand-drawn bar under each trolley, the full one's three times longer and hatched.
shots.motion: The bars draw on; the full one's marker swipe.
shots.transition: The empty trolley rolls onto a scale.
shots.check: The bars are in the ratio 1 : 3.

frames.note: Two trolleys side by side on one floor.
Labels under them: massa kecil, massa besar.
Bars for 'susah diubah': 1 and 3.

shots.voice: Troli kosong cuma sekitar *dua puluh satu kilo*.
shots.teaches: A real trolley: an empty one weighs about 21 kg.
shots.screen: The empty trolley on a big platform scale drawn on the floor; the scale's window reads 21 kg; small note 'Wanzl ELT7/130, 131 liter'.
shots.motion: The trolley rolls onto the scale; the reading writes on.
shots.check: The number is 21, as the fact sheet says.

frames.note: The empty trolley rolls in from the left.
The empty trolley stands on the scale.
The reading: 21 kg, and the model's name small.

shots.voice: Tambah belanjaan empat puluh dua kilo,
shots.teaches: A real week's shop goes in: 42 kg of it.
shots.screen: Boxes and bags drop one by one into the empty trolley standing on the scale; each lands with a squash.
shots.motion: Each item drops and squashes into the basket on twos; the scale's needle waits.
shots.transition: Continuous: the reading changes on the next line.
shots.sound: Three thumps as the items land.
shots.check: The items land inside the basket, not floating.

frames.note: Shopping falls into the basket from above.
The basket is full; label '+42 kg'.

shots.teaches: 21 + 42 = 63 kg: three times the empty trolley.
shots.screen: The scale reads 63 kg; above it '21 + 42 = 63 kg' and a big '3×' with the marker.
shots.motion: The reading changes once; the sum writes on; the marker swipes under 3×.
shots.carries: The full trolley on the scale.

frames.note: The scale's reading turns to 63 kg; the sum writes on.
The big 3× with its marker swipe.

shots.voice: Artinya, dorongan yang sama cuma bikin dia ngebut *sepertiganya*.
shots.teaches: Same push, three times the mass: a third of the acceleration, so in the same time it gets a third as far.
shots.screen: Two lanes, one above the other. Top: empty trolley with a push arrow F on its handle. Bottom: full trolley with the same arrow F. A dashed start line; when the push ends the empty one has gone 560 px, the full one 187 px: brackets 'jauh' and 'cuma ⅓'.
shots.motion: Both arrows are drawn the same length first; both trolleys are pushed for the same time (on twos), the full one gaining speed at a third of the rate; the arrows are rubbed out when the push ends, the brackets are drawn, and both roll on at the speed they have (the empty one out of the frame).
shots.transition: Hold on the gap, then the full lane fills the frame.
shots.sound: Two rolls, one long, one short.

frames.note: Two lanes, same push arrow F on each.
Both move for the same time.
Where they are after the same time: 3 : 1.

shots.teaches: Turn: inertia also works the other way.
shots.screen: The full trolley now rolling along the floor with speed lines; the figure walking behind it.
shots.motion: It rolls on at a steady speed with speed lines; the figure runs after it (on twos); the camera travels with the trolley along the floor, its tiles going by.
shots.transition: Continuous: the figure grabs the handle.
shots.check: It reads as moving, not standing.

frames.note: Rolling, speed lines behind.
Still rolling; the figure catches up.

shots.voice: Begitu udah jalan, dia juga ogah *berhenti*.
shots.teaches: Inertia, part two: what moves keeps moving; stopping a big mass is hard too.
shots.screen: The figure leans back on the handle, heels dug in; the trolley keeps rolling and drags them along; label 'maunya tetap jalan'.
shots.motion: His arm reaches the handle over four drawings; he leans back, heels dug in and sliding (skid lines); the trolley slows but is still rolling when the page turns.
shots.sound: Shoes squeak as the heels slide.
shots.check: The figure leans backwards, the opposite of s01.

frames.note: Grabbing the handle, starting to lean back.
Leaning back, heels skidding; the trolley rolls on.
Label 'maunya tetap jalan'.

shots.voice: Kalau kamu ngerem sekuat tadi, jaraknya *tiga kali* lebih panjang.
shots.teaches: Same braking force from the same speed: the full trolley needs three times the distance to stop.
shots.screen: Two lanes again, both trolleys arriving at the same speed at a dashed line 'mulai ngerem'; while each brakes, the same arrow F as in s09 turned round on its handle ('sekuat tadi'); skid marks and brackets grow from the line: 180 px for the empty one, 540 px for the full one; '1' and '× 3' in marker.
shots.motion: Both brake at the line at the same moment; the empty one stops early, the full one slides on; '× 3' is written as it stops, on 'tiga kali', and held for a second before the page turns.
shots.transition: The lanes slide away; one frame of the summary.
shots.sound: Two skids, the second three times as long.

frames.note: Both arrive at the braking line at the same speed.
The empty one has stopped; the full one is still sliding.
Both stopped: marks 1 and 3; '×3'.

shots.voice: Jadi yang bikin capek itu *massanya*, bukan beratnya.
shots.teaches: The answer in one frame: you fight the mass (inertia), not the weight.
shots.screen: One page: at the top 'massa ✓' with the marker and 'berat' crossed out, and under them, small, '(terutama saat mulai & berhenti)' (f7); then the two ideas as small drawings in a column: 'susah mulai' (figure pushing, arrow forward), 'susah berhenti' (figure leaning back on a rolling trolley, arrow back, skid lines).
shots.motion: The two small drawings draw on; 'berat' is crossed out on 'bukan'.
shots.transition: The opening page is laid back over it.
shots.sound: Two ticks and a cross-out scratch.
shots.check: Readable as a summary with the sound off.

frames.note: The two words at the top.
Two small drawings: hard to start, hard to stop.
'berat' crossed out.

shots.teaches: The bridge back into the first line.
shots.screen: Back to the opening picture: the figure leaning into the full trolley, the same pixels as frame 0.
shots.motion: The page slides back; the figure settles into the s01 pose a moment before frame 0.
shots.transition: No cut: the film loops straight into s01.
shots.sound: The bed runs on into the opening.
shots.check: The last frame matches frame 0 (check.mjs SSIM).

frames.note: The page slides back to the opening picture.
The opening picture, a moment before frame 0.
